implementation: independent implementation of paper Appendix A; official complete code not located
training: none; no parameter or prompt selection using validation labels
system_and_user_prompt: verbatim functional prompts from Appendix A; scripts/reze_core.py

scoring.both_present: two-way softmax of Yes and No log probabilities
scoring.no_absent: full-vocabulary Yes probability, as in published code

hd_readout: inclusive integer-second endpoints; average overlaps; nearest fill/extrapolation; mean each consecutive 2 seconds; no smoothing, thresholding, or normalization

local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.decode: decord, original presentation timestamps, last frame starting at or before requested time
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.sampling: equally spaced, start inclusive/end exclusive; full segment: 0,.5,1,1.5,2,2.5 seconds
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.residual_frames: max(2, round(segment_duration * 2)); native processor temporally pads odd counts
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.timeline: segment min(annotation_duration, decoded_end); map to annotation grid with published nearest fill
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.frame_resize: qwen-vl-utils smart_resize factor32, min131072/max786432 pixels per frame; bicubic antialias
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.native_video: joint THWC frames with local clip fps and timestamps; processor resampling/resizing disabled
local_choices_not_fully_specified_by_pap.engine: TP1, max_len4096, max_seqs8, max_batched_tokens4096, eager, prefix cache disabled, seed0, fixed 1GiB KV cache, skip automatic multimodal profiling

failure_policy: preserve failures, stop rather than omit or synthesize predictions; at most 2 automatic worker restarts using completed per-query checkpoints
comparison_scope: same full validation queries and official HD evaluator as local CLIP/VTG-GPT/MERIT; paper headline test scores are a different split
